_comment: Records which key may sign a release; it holds no key. A card-backed private key is never
exportable, so it can never be a build secret: ciSigning stays false and CI builds unsigned.
state 'Unconfigured' means no certificate exists, and the signing script refuses then. Values
here must come from an issued certificate - never invented.
provider: Certum SimplySign (Open Source Code Signing in the Cloud) - not purchased

notes.hashes: a signature appends to the file, so every published SHA-256 is taken after signing
notes.licence: signing adds no restriction: GPL-3.0-only, and a rebuilt binary is unsigned
